title: Perspective Lab — Evidence & Reflection Prompts
description: Optional prompts to help users separate observations from assumptions, consider evidence and uncertainty, and identify fair next steps.

defaultPrompts.unknowns: What do I still not know?

prompts.text: What happened that someone else could observe?
Which part of the situation is a fact, and which is my interpretation?
What exact words or actions am I reacting to?
What did I notice, and what am I filling in?
What information would help me understand the situation better?
Which details am I most certain about?
Which details might I be remembering imperfectly?
What happened just before I drew this conclusion?
What specific evidence supports my interpretation?
Have I seen this pattern more than once?
Is this based on someone's actions or on what I fear they think?
What would I point to if explaining my view to a friend?
Are there examples that genuinely support my concern?
What evidence is recent, and what comes from older experiences?
Am I relying on one moment to explain a larger pattern?
Does the evidence support my full conclusion or only part of it?
What facts don't fit my first interpretation?
Could the same behavior have another explanation?
What might I notice if I were less certain of my first conclusion?
Has this person or situation been different at other times?
What would someone with a different perspective point out?
Am I overlooking a practical or ordinary explanation?
What would I tell a friend who had the same concern?
What would make me reconsider this interpretation?
What do I not know yet?
Am I assuming I know someone else's intentions?
What outcome am I predicting without enough information?
Could more than one interpretation be true?
What question could I ask to get clarity?
What could remain uncertain even after I ask?
Can I leave this unresolved for now?
What is within my control while I wait for more information?
What makes this situation particularly important to me?
Which value or need feels affected here?
What feeling is my first interpretation connected to?
What boundary might be reasonable regardless of the explanation?
What would a fair and respectful response look like?
What is one small step I can take without assuming the worst?
What part of my concern deserves attention even if my guess is wrong?
What interpretation helps me stay open to facts and protect my needs?
